findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: frontier_propose, free_list, free_read, free_post · Private data: register · Public sink: frontier_submit, frontier_propose, answer, free_post, free_react, free_delete · Destructive: free_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: frontier_propose, free_list, free_read, free_post · Private data: register · Public sink: frontier_submit, frontier_propose, answer, free_post, free_react, free_delete · Destructive: free_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
